title: 3D Ground Grid Issue
content:
I used to uncheck the ground grid in the 3D window and that was fine until I want it visible again. Now I uncheck it from the 'Environment Display' in the 3D window then I go to 'New Garment' and with the garment there the 3D grid shoes up again.

It never happened before, I could work without it until I decided to reactivate it.

Now for any new project, the omnipresent 3D grid is there.

Any ideas?

Thank you in advance for any inputs.

MarkTM![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/a045c9b605194cedab357fe5a4cfbfb6/images/8b1d4b94935648f896e5814aa0d330c6Screenshot%202025-04-15%20at%2019.32.08.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Melody, thank you SO much for your reply, I do apologise for 'my' late reply.Your suggestion confirms what I have already found out.Now I can be sure it will work and stay that way.again thank you THANK YOU for your help!

Comment 2: Hi there, please excuse the inconvenience. I can replicate and will report; I am unaware as of now whether this is a glitch or has been changed on purpose, but will let you know as soon as I know more.
Reply 1: Thank you melody!! very nice of you! Will wait to hear from you about it.❤️
Reply 2: Hi Mark, please excuse the late reply. Starting from version 2025.0, the way the display settings (toggled in the 3D/2D views) are handled has been changed; instead of saving them to the registry, they are now managed through the display settings system.Therefore, when Ctrl+N is used, it loads the Default_Modelist.zprj file and applies the settings saved in that file. As a result, this behavior is expected and not considered a bug.As a workaround, under main menu --> Settings --> User Settings --> Default Files, you can replace the new default project with a blank file that doesn't have the ground grid turned on.
content_description: A troubleshooting guide addressing persistent 3D grid visibility issues in garment design software.

title: ruffles custom angle
content:
Hi, 

I am trying to change the sewing type line from turned to custom angle so that my ruffles look down (180>360) and not up (180>0). The problem is that the custom angle option showing in the drop down menu looks not active and therefore not clickable (see images below). Could you please help me on this one?

My clo3d version is 7.3 due to computer version, and I cannot upgrade.

If there is no option to solve this problem, do you know another way of flattening ruffles in a certain direction?

Thanks

Best

Bren![d4dfd2667a154e38b061a24d07e256ba](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/c03ada1c68c543069969a24a94f16045/images/d4dfd2667a154e38b061a24d07e256baScreenshot%202025-04-14%20at%2019.21.18.png)

Comment 1: Hi Brenda. Could you add images of 2D and 3D windows. The mor information we have the better we can assist without having to ask lots of questions-What is the ruffle sewn to? Is it sewn to an Internal Line or a Pattern Edge?\When you have Turned Selected the options below will be greyed out as CLO then "Turns" your seam allowance to be flat against the fabric.You will need to switch to Custom angle. This will give you control of the Angle of the seam allowance being pressed. Please Note that custom angle will only be an option if you are sewing edge to edge (no internal lines)Hopefully this helps. Otherwise you will need to add more information as noted above

title: Importing DXF and PDF
content:
Hello, I am trying to import a DXF from Gerber as aama. At first I thought it opened well and I had in the pattern a reference box that's 10*10 cm it opened the right size. However, when I checked the pattern pieces themselves they had a difference of 1 cm in each piece that's less than the original pattern. 

Also another option I tried was importing a pdf from illustrator, but it always opens with a bounding box that I can't get rid of. 

So would appreciate any tips on importing DXFs of PDFs from either programs.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi There!For exporting from Gerber, did you check to make sure the export size settings were correct. Then also check the size settings when importing to CLO.For Illustrator before you finish in Ai did you make sure each pattern piece is a closed shape? This means the points must be connected, not just overlapping. Also, when importing to you go to File > Import < Adobe?
content_description: Providing tips and solutions for accurately importing DXF and PDF files from Gerber and Illustrator without size discrepancies or unwanted bounding boxes.

title: CLO 2025.0 is officially here!
content:
![49508ce1f9bf43c9a5823473964c49b3](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/6ba374550f414138a8d1585cab3839b4/images/49508ce1f9bf43c9a5823473964c49b3release25_scoop_en.png)

CLO 2025.0 has added 42 new features, making CLO even more powerful than our previous versions.  


**CLO 2025.0 Highlight Features:**

  


  * **Key Frame Animation:** Elevate animations by applying keyframes to various components, creating dynamic and sophisticated visuals.

  * **Pattern Drafter:** Create and edit accurate parametric patterns with minimal measurements. Additionally, instantly generate them from a schematic sketch image.

  * **AI Pose Generator:** Effortlessly create avatar poses using keywords or an image.

  * **Avatar IK Joint Mapping:** Streamline IK joint mapping for various avatars to achieve natural movement while ensuring seamless compatibility for motions and poses across all avatars.

  * **Avatar Hip Shape:** Create a variety of hip shapes with hip dip and upper volume customization.

  * **Texture-Based Nesting:** Optimize pattern placement with minimal waste, while maintaining texture and prints.

  * **Advanced Pinching:** Express more realistic wrinkles and shapes with precise pinching, just like pulling real fabric.

  * **GPU Rendering on macOS:** Unlock faster, more efficient rendering performance with GPU rendering on macOS.

  * **Fur Generation:** Generate various types of fur in real-time, with compatibility across multiple platforms.




Discover even more features of 2025.0 right [_HERE_](https://clo3d.com/en/clo/features) and [_DOWNLOAD_](https://clo3d.com/en/clo/download) it today.

Stay tuned for our upcoming webinar, where you can learn more about the new features. Check out our [_2025.0 WEBINAR SCHEDULE_](https://connect.clo-set.com/community?postId=d7f96f66723641f6a84f75a1eb4e38f8)!

title: 클로 패턴에서의 dxf 와 유카캐드 프로그램에서의 호환성
content:
clo로 패턴작업을 하여 dxf로 내보내 yuka 프로그램으로 옮겨 작업을 해야하는데

항상 dxf파일로 내보낼때 유카 프로그램과의 호환성 문제가 있습니다.

테스트를 항상 해보지만 해결이 안되는건 기초선 문제, 주석 및 클로 파일 제목(패턴명 오류)

클로에서 dxf 파일로 저장을 했을때 패턴이 2장으로 겹쳐짐의 문제가 정말 문제가 있다고 생각합니다. (이 부분의 문제는 유카와의 호환성의 문제가 아닌 클로 자체적인 버그 같습니다.)

클로에서 dxf로 내보내고 다시 클로 프로그램에서 저장한 dxf 파일을 열었을때 2장으로 겹쳐진 파일을 확인 할 수 있습니다. 저는 맥북으로 작업을 하고 있습니다.

저는 단지 클로를 3d프로그램만이 아닌 실물로 만들고 생산까지 하는 프로그래머이기 때문에 이런 부문에 있어서는 일을 두번하지 않게 버그를 clo에서 고쳐주셨으면 하는 바람입니다. (시급함.)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: 안녕하세요. 질문해 주셔서 감사합니다. 귀하의 계정에 연결된 CLO 라이선스가 없는 것 같습니다. 활성 CL0 라이선스에 연결된 CL0 ID가 무엇인지 알려주시겠습니까?
content_description: 이 웹페이지는 CLO에서 DXF 파일 내보내기 시 발생하는 패턴 겹침 및 호환성 문제와 관련된 버그를 공유하고 개선을 요청하기 위해 제작되었습니다.
